title: AuthoringHint
description: JSON Schema mirror of the gzkit.complexity.authoring.hint.AuthoringHint Pydantic model (OBPI-0.0.30-03). Note: the cross-field constraint start_line <= end_line is enforced by the Pydantic model_validator; Draft 2020-12 has no portable cross-field comparator.

crossing_value.description: Observed metric value that triggered the hint.

doctrinal_frame_headline.description: Truncated one-line excerpt of the cited doctrinal frame.

file_path.description: Source file path for the editor to navigate to.

end_line.description: Last line (1-indexed, inclusive). The cross-field constraint end_line >= start_line is enforced by the Pydantic model_validator.
